source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique IB identity; OOB counterpart confirms standard App 0x0C/0x02 read semantics.

source_snapshot.procedure: Read selectors 0x00,03,04,05,06,0A,0C with App 0x0C/0x02 by IB and OOB, then compare ipmitool lan print; generic pre-step clears logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Commands succeed and response data matches lan print.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES but omits required raw selector coverage and uses unsafe SSH.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE with exact selector parser and protected comparison.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 makes channel/reference Project inputs; ED-38 no retry.

original_test_intent: Read and decode each approved LAN parameter through IB and OOB, then verify selector-specific raw values agree with protected high-level LAN state without mutation.
original_method: Use App 0x0C/0x02 with explicit channel/selector/set/block values, type-aware decoding and independent lan print comparison.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies approved channel/selectors and expected LAN baseline once; reads need no action confirmation.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient: lan print alone omits the original raw selector and dual-path coverage and exposes credentials.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected raw 0x0C/0x02 per selector plus protected lan print, with no sshpass/-P and a pinned decoder.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original selectors, commands and 10/5 timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Read every approved selector on required paths, validate selector echo/length/encoding, normalize IP/MAC/mask/ARP/gateway fields and compare the same target's lan print without remediation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds safe transport, automatic parsing and fail-closed comparison while retaining all reads.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Only current configuration is covered; LAN setters and reachability transitions are separate.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong channel or byte order can misidentify management network state.

project_override_considerations: High-level APIs may supplement but not replace raw selector/path coverage unless Project SPEC explicitly approves equivalent evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek executes only lan print and misses raw/dual-path coverage; source examples expose credentials and clear logs. Criteria needs explicit selector/encoding comparison, not user judgment.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Commands/selectors are explicit; parser and baseline are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Restores the omitted raw selector and IB/OOB coverage with structured comparison and safe credentials.
independent_technical_reasoning: The operation is read-only and fully specified enough for a versioned parser. Once channel and reference are supplied, all collection and comparison steps are deterministic, supporting FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
